issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares RollerCoaster.numberOfLoopings as type int, but the solution implementation declares the attribute as long and its getter returns long. This mismatch between the specified attribute type and the provided implementation can confuse students about which type to use for numberOfLoopings and may lead to failing tests or inconsistent implementations.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the attribute type consistent with the UML/specification. Either change the RollerCoaster attribute and getter in the solution/template to use int (preferred to match the UML), i.e., private int numberOfLoopings; public int getNumberOfLoopings(), or update the problem statement/UML to declare numberOfLoopings as long if long is intended.
